pages.text: Use a Wrench to configure $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:power/wireless)Wireless FE Batteries$(/l) and the $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:power/rainbow_generator)Rainbow Generator$(/l). For wireless power, select the receiver first. For Rainbow power, sneak-right-click the Rainbow core first.
Using the Wrench on a compatible fluid tank can also report the fluid and amount.
